question: A regular octagon is paved inside a circular traffic junction. What is the sum of all internal angles?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any **regular polygon** with **n sides**, the sum of all internal angles is calculated using the property (n − 2) × 180°.

An **octagon** has n = 8 sides.

Sum = (8 − 2) × 180°

Sum = 6 × 180° = 1080°.

**∴ The correct answer is 1080°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The polygon is a **regular octagon** paved inside a circular traffic junction.

⇒ Number of sides (n) = 8

**Formula Used:**

Sum of all internal angles of a polygon = (n − 2) × 180°

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e30de74df0377bb00311bd0252003a3053cc75d04beccaf56237679e1472a2d.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total interior angles = (8 − 2) × 180°

⇒ Total interior angles = 6 × 180°

⇒ Total interior angles = 1080°

**∴ The correct answer is 1080°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Interior Angle of a Regular Polygon

Each interior angle of a regular polygon is given by [(n − 2) × 180°] ÷ n. For an octagon, this is 1080° ÷ 8 = 135°.

Sum of Exterior Angles

The sum of the exterior angles of any convex polygon is always 360°, regardless of the number of sides.

Relation between Interior and Exterior Angles

At each vertex of a polygon, the sum of the interior angle and the corresponding exterior angle is always 180°.</p
